name: Pistachio Hotel Sapa
vi: Khách sạn Pistachio Sapa, Tổ 5 đường Thác Bạc, phường Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: To 5, Thac Bac Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai 661300
tip: Pool has a midday closure (11:30-13:00) - the Tue 08:45-10:15 swim is inside the morning window, but do not drift past 11:30. Bags can be left at reception before the 14:00 check-in, which is what the 05:30 bus arrival depends on; confirm by email in advance.
why: Base hotel; 12th-floor outdoor infinity pool next to Fansi Sky Bar, the only one in the town centre.
near: Thac Bac street, ~400 m uphill from Sun Plaza

name: Pho Ga Hoang Ngan
vi: Phở Gà Hoàng Ngân, cạnh Nhà thờ Đá, trung tâm Sa Pa
addr: Beside Sapa Stone Church, town centre, Sa Pa
hours: Breakfast only; opens early, closes when the broth runs out (aim before 08:30)
tip: The named pho ga the plan is missing - it is literally next to the Stone Church, so the 06:15-07:15 slot works. Sapa pho ga has a clear chicken-bone broth, not Hanoi-style. Cash only.
why: The specific well-known pho ga by the central square/church, matching the Sun 06:15 breakfast slot.
near: Sapa Stone Church / central square

name: Sun World Fansipan Legend (board at Sun Plaza)
vi: Sun World Fansipan Legend, ga Sun Plaza, đường Nguyễn Chí Thanh / Fansipan, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: Sun Plaza station, Nguyen Chi Thanh / Fansipan Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
hours: Sun 07:30-14:30; Sat 07:30-15:30; Mon-Thu 08:00-14:30; Fri 08:00-15:30. CLOSED FOR MAINTENANCE 21-27 Sep 2026 (cable car + both funiculars), reopening 28 Sep.
price: Cable car round trip 850,000 VND adult / 550,000 child (1.0-1.4 m). Cable car + Muong Hoa funicular + summit funicular combo 1,370,000 adult / 1,070,000 child. Under 1 m free. Sat/holiday surcharge 50,000 on adult cable car.
tip: The plan's assumption is right: 20 Sep 2026 IS the last operating day before the annual shutdown - which is exactly why it will be the busiest day of the month, on a Sunday. Buy the combo ticket online the night before and be at Sun Plaza for the 07:30 first departure. There is no fallback day on this trip.
why: Core stop; zero walking on the combo ticket - funicular from Sun Plaza, cable car, then summit funicular to 3,143 m.
near: Sun Plaza, town centre

name: Con Sui Ong Ha
vi: Cốn Sủi Ông Há, 591 Điện Biên Phủ, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 591 Dien Bien Phu, Sa Pa, Lao Cai (some listings say 436 Dien Bien Phu)
tip: Closes at 14:00, so the 11:45-13:00 slot is the last safe window. It is on Dien Bien Phu, roughly 1.5 km downhill/north-east of Sun Plaza - not a walk after a morning on the mountain, take a taxi. Cash.
why: Seven-generation con sui (flat wheat noodles in thick savoury sauce, not clear broth) - the Sapa dish most worth the detour.
near: Dien Bien Phu, same street as the HK Buslines office

name: Alpine Coaster Sapa (Ban Mong)
vi: Xe trượt núi Alpine Coaster, Tổ 3, Cầu Mây (bản Mòng), Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: To 3, Cau May (Ban Mong), Sa Pa, Lao Cai
hours: Reported 07:00-18:30 or 09:00-18:00 daily; may close in heavy rain/fog
price: 200,000-250,000 VND adult per ride; ~100,000 VND child 90-135 cm riding with an adult
tip: Roughly 3.5 km south-east of the square, not 5 km, but it is a real taxi hop and Grab cover thins out there - ask the driver to wait or take his number. Over 1,000 m of track, ~30 min per experience. Wet track = closure, so check the same morning.
why: Longest alpine coaster in Vietnam; zero-effort thrill with valley views, fits the no-hiking rule.
near: Cau May / Ban Mong, ~3.5 km SE of Sapa square

name: Nha Hang A Phu
vi: Nhà hàng A Phủ, 15 đường Fansipan, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 15 Fansipan Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
tip: Salmon hotpot is the house dish; sturgeon and salmon are usually priced per kg, so agree the fish weight before they cook it. Book ahead for 17:30 on a Sunday.
why: The better-known of the two hotpot options; Tay Bac specialities (thang co, lon cap nach) alongside the salmon/sturgeon hotpot.
near: Fansipan Street, ~5 min walk from Sun Plaza

name: Hotpot Center Sapa
vi: Nhà hàng Lẩu Hotpot Center Sapa, 71 Xuân Viên, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 71 Xuan Vien, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
tip: Overlooks Sapa Lake and is a 2-minute walk from it, so it chains straight into the evening lake/night-market leg better than A Phu does. Menu is largely Vietnamese-only and staff use translation apps - screenshot the dish names first. Sturgeon hotpot is the pick.
why: Lake-view hotpot with 200+ dishes; the plan's second hotpot option and the more convenient one for the 19:30 night-market move.
near: Sapa Lake / Xuan Vien

name: Sapa Night Market (N1 street)
vi: Chợ đêm Sa Pa, đường N1, tổ 3B, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: N1 street, group 3B, at the Lao Cai Information and Tourism Promotion Centre, Sa Pa
hours: Fri, Sat and Sun 16:00-22:00 (many stalls run to around midnight); busiest 20:00-22:00
tip: Sunday IS a market night - the plan is safe. But this is the modern night market, not the historic 'love market'; do not expect an ethnic courtship ceremony. Bring small notes, stalls are cash-only and haggling is expected.
why: Grilled skewers, thang co, brocade stalls; the 19:30-21:30 slot lands exactly on the peak hours.
near: Town centre, walkable from Sapa Lake and the square

name: Sapa Stone Church (Our Lady of the Rosary)
vi: Nhà thờ Đá Sa Pa (Nhà thờ Đức Mẹ Mân Côi), phố Hàm Rồng, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: Ham Rong Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
hours: Interior Mon-Sat 07:00-18:00, Sun 09:00-18:00. Sunday Mass 09:00 and 19:00.
tip: The 19:30-21:30 slot is after the interior closes at 18:00, and a Sunday evening Mass runs at 19:00 - so plan on the floodlit exterior only. That is the Xiaohongshu shot anyway; the square in front is where the crowds and the photos are.
why: The town's landmark and the anchor of the central square; free, floodlit, zero effort.
near: Central square, next to the pho ga breakfast stop

name: Cat Cat Village
vi: Bản Cát Cát, đường Cát Cát (nối đường Fansipan), Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: Cat Cat Road, ~2 km downhill from Sapa town centre, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
price: 150,000 VND adult, 70,000 VND child up to 1.3 m. Rainbow slide 40,000 VND per ride (separate). Electric buggy from Gate 2 down to the village centre 10,000 VND per person per trip.
tip: Tickets are sold at the gate, cash only - no card, no online. Going down is easy, coming back up is the strenuous part the plan rightly avoids: take a xe om from the bottom exit (50,000-60,000 VND/person) or a car (80,000-120,000 VND). Arrive by 09:45 as planned; tour groups land from about 09:30.
why: Waterwheels, waterfall, suspension bridge and Hmong houses; entry includes the dance show, and the route is all downhill.
near: Bottom of Fansipan Street, ~2 km from Sapa square

name: Nha Hang O Quy Ho
vi: Nhà hàng Ô Quý Hồ, 08 Thạch Sơn, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 08 Thach Son, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
price: Sturgeon priced by weight, around 180,000-250,000 VND/kg; reviewers call it not cheap but generous portions
tip: Note the spelling: the sign and website are 'Ô Quý Hồ', not 'Ô Quy Hồ' - useful when showing a driver. It is in the town centre on Thach Son, NOT out at the O Quy Ho pass, so the 12:15 arrival from Cat Cat is a short taxi. Com lam and grilled pork are the reason to come.
why: Tay Bac specialities - com lam in bamboo, charcoal-grilled goat and pork, black chicken - with a valley view from the tables.
near: Thach Son, town centre, 3 min from the square

name: Dao's Care (Red Dao herbal bath)
vi: Dao's Care, số 26 phố Đồng Lợi, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 26 Dong Loi Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
price: From ~200,000 VND per herbal bath session; couple and private rooms available at higher rates
tip: The 13:30-14:30 slot is tight - a proper bath is 20-30 min in the tub plus changing, and you should not go straight from a hot herbal bath into a 15-minute walk. If the day is running late, this is the right thing to drop, exactly as the plan allows. Book in the morning; the couple room is the one that sells out.
why: The signature Sapa wellness stop; a social enterprise employing Red Dao women, well regarded and central.
near: Dong Loi Street, 5 min walk from Hotel de la Coupole

name: Absinthe Bar & Lounge, Hotel de la Coupole MGallery
vi: Absinthe Bar, tầng 10 Hotel de la Coupole MGallery, số 1 đường Hoàng Liên, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 10th floor, Hotel de la Coupole - MGallery, 1 Hoang Lien Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai 33000
hours: 11:00-23:00 daily (some listings say to midnight). No children admitted after 18:00.
tip: The afternoon tea price is NOT published anywhere - call or email minhanh.do@accor.com to book and get the current rate. The 14:45-17:00 slot is well inside opening hours. Ask for the outdoor fireplace terrace; if it is fogged in, the indoor Bensley interior is the photo anyway.
why: Rooftop bar on the 10th floor with an open fireplace and Sapa skyline views; Bill Bensley's Coco Chanel-inspired interior is heavily photographed on Xiaohongshu.
near: Hoang Lien Street, next to Sun Plaza

name: Moana Sapa
vi: Moana Sapa, số 68 đường Violet, phường Cầu Mây, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 68 Violet Street, Cau May Ward, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
hours: 07:00-17:00 (some sources 07:00-19:00); ticket sales reported to stop around 16:30
price: 80,000-90,000 VND basic ticket (often includes a drink); combo packages 150,000-180,000 VND
tip: The 17:15-18:30 slot is a real risk - ticketing reportedly stops around 16:30 and the site closes at 17:00 on the conservative reading. Move Moana earlier (swap it with the Absinthe tea) or confirm the closing time by phone that morning. All photo-set fees are included in the ticket, no per-spot surcharges. ~3 km from the square, 10-15 min by taxi.
why: The Xiaohongshu/Instagram set piece - Bali 'Gate of Heaven' replica, infinity deck and sky swings framed on Fansipan and the terraces.
near: Violet Street, Cau May ward, ~3 km SE of the centre

name: Sapa Lake (Ho Sa Pa)
vi: Hồ Sa Pa, khu vực Xuân Viên, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: Xuan Vien area, town centre, Sa Pa
tip: A full loop on the fenced footpath is about 30 minutes at a stroll, 10 minutes brisk - flat and paved, so it suits the no-hiking rule. Evening is the better light: the lake mirrors the town lights.
why: Flat lakeside loop linking the hotpot restaurants, Le Gecko and the night market; the reflection shots are the reason to come at dusk.
near: Between Hotpot Center, Le Gecko and the night market

name: Le Gecko Cafe
vi: Le Gecko Cafe, số 2 đường Ngũ Chỉ Sơn, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 2 Ngu Chi Son Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai 330000
tip: Ask for the third floor or the outdoor terrace - that is where the lake and Fansipan view is; the ground floor has none of it. Open to 23:00, so the 18:45-21:00 slot is comfortable.
why: French-leaning cafe right by the lake with a genuine third-floor view; reliable coffee and a Vietnamese menu alongside the Western one.
near: Sapa Lake, 2 min from Hotpot Center

name: THE MIST SAPA
vi: THE MIST SAPA, 11A phố Thác Bạc, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 11A Thac Bac Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai 330000
hours: 07:30-20:00, CLOSED MONDAYS (one source reports a ~17:00 close)
tip: It is on Thac Bac - the same street as Pistachio, a few minutes' walk, not on Hoang Lien as the plan has it. That makes it the better of the two Tuesday options: walk from check-out, no taxi, and back at the hotel in time for the 12:30 pick-up. Closed Mondays, which does not affect a Tuesday visit. Egg coffee and coconut coffee are the orders; resident cats and dogs roam.
why: 4.9 stars over 1,500+ reviews, cloud-facing deck, and the closest quality cafe to the hotel for the final morning.
near: Thac Bac Street - walking distance from Pistachio Hotel

name: Viettrekking Coffee & Restaurant
vi: Viettrekking Coffee & Restaurant, 33 đường Hoàng Liên, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 33 Hoang Lien, TT. Sa Pa, Lao Cai 333320
tip: This is the Hoang Lien cliffside deck the plan means. The famous shot is the Muong Hoa funicular gliding through the green hills below the terrace - but the cloud sea is an October-April, before-08:00 phenomenon, so a 10:45 visit in September gets the valley, not the clouds. If you want the clouds, this is a sunrise stop, not a check-out stop.
why: The defining Sapa view cafe - carved timber room aimed at a glass wall over Muong Hoa valley and the Hoang Lien Son range.
near: Hoang Lien Street, near Hotel de la Coupole and Sun Plaza

name: HK Buslines Sapa office
vi: Nhà xe HK Buslines, 697 Điện Biên Phủ, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 697 Dien Bien Phu, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
hours: About 20 departures a day from Sapa to Hanoi
tip: HK does not run the big limousine to the hotel door. A shuttle collects from hotels in the Sapa centre zone and takes you to the office at 697 Dien Bien Phu, where the limousine actually departs. So a 12:30 'pick-up at Pistachio' means the shuttle, and the real departure is later - reconfirm with HK the day before, and treat 12:30 as a hard checkout deadline, not a soft one.
why: Departure point for the Hanoi leg; the pick-up mechanics change how tight Tuesday morning is.
near: Dien Bien Phu, same street as Con Sui Ong Ha

name: Sapa Sky View Restaurant & Bar
vi: Sapa Sky View, tầng thượng khách sạn Châu Long, 24 phố Đồng Lợi, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: Rooftop of Chau Long Hotel, 24 Dong Loi Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
tip: Open to non-guests. The circular brick window framing the Fansipan range is the photo everyone comes for; at night the lights climbing the mountain are the better version. 4.5 stars over 670+ reviews.
why: A second rooftop option a 4-minute walk from Dao's Care on the same street - the Monday backup if Absinthe is booked out or too pricey.
near: Dong Loi Street - beside Dao's Care, near Hotel de la Coupole

name: White Cloud Cafe
vi: White Cloud Cafe, 65 đường Fansipan, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 65 Fansipan Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
tip: The round window looking straight at the peaks is the Xiaohongshu frame - get there before the queue for that one seat. Egg coffee and coconut iced coffee are the orders.
why: Cheap, photogenic and 50 m from Nha Hang A Phu at 15 Fansipan - a natural pre-dinner stop on Sunday evening.
near: Fansipan Street, beside Nha Hang A Phu

name: Fansipan Terrace Cafe
vi: Fansipan Terrace Cafe, 67 đường Fansipan, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 67 Fansipan Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
tip: Opens 06:30, which is the point - it is the only view terrace serving before the 07:30 Fansipan departure on Sunday. Direct line of sight down Muong Hoa valley.
why: Earliest-opening view cafe in town; a coffee here before Sun Plaza on Sunday costs nothing in time.
near: Fansipan Street, 5 min walk from Sun Plaza

name: Baguette & Chocolat Cafe
vi: Baguette & Chocolat, trung tâm Sa Pa (gần nhà thờ và chợ)
addr: Central Sa Pa, about 5 min from the market and the church
tip: A hospitality-training social enterprise; the pastry counter and cakes are the draw and prices are low for what it is. Cash is safest.
why: The best-regarded bakery in the centre, 5 min from the Stone Church - a pastry-and-coffee filler for the Sunday breakfast hour or the Monday gap.
near: Town centre, near Sapa Stone Church and the day market

name: The French Bakery
vi: The French Bakery, cuối phố Cầu Mây, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: End of Cau May Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
tip: The almond brownie and the chocolate tart are the recommended items; pair with a black Vietnamese coffee. Cau May is the main tourist strip, so it is on the way to almost everything in the centre.
why: Dessert stop on Cau May, a couple of minutes from Quan O Quy Ho and the square - fits the Monday afternoon gap.
near: Cau May Street, near Quan O Quy Ho

name: Cong Caphe Sapa
vi: Cộng Cà Phê Sa Pa, đường Fansipan, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: Fansipan Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
tip: Order the coconut coffee (ca phe cot dua) - it is what the chain is known for. The Sapa branch's military-nostalgia interior against the mountain backdrop is a standard Xiaohongshu frame.
why: Reliable, card-friendly chain on Fansipan Street; a wet-weather fallback near Cat Cat road and the Fansipan Street cafes.
near: Fansipan Street, on the way down to Cat Cat

name: Sapa Market (Cho Sa Pa)
vi: Chợ Sa Pa, đường Lương Định Của, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: Luong Dinh Cua Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai
tip: This is the daytime market, a different place from the N1 night market - upstairs is the food court where locals eat, downstairs is produce and brocade. Better value than the night market for textiles.
why: Two minutes from the night market site and the lake; worth 20 minutes for food-court snacks and the produce hall.
near: Beside the night market area, walkable from Sapa Lake

name: Hotel de la Coupole MGallery - lobby and facade
vi: Hotel de la Coupole MGallery, số 1 đường Hoàng Liên, Sa Pa, Lào Cai
addr: 1 Hoang Lien Street, Sa Pa, Lao Cai 33000
hours: Public areas accessible when the hotel is open; be discreet, it is a working hotel
price: Free (you are already paying for the rooftop bar upstairs)
tip: Bill Bensley's colonial-couture interiors - the grand staircase, the pink corridors and the courtyard facade - are among the most-posted Sapa frames on Xiaohongshu, and you get them free on the way up to Absinthe. Shoot before you sit down, while the light is still up.
why: Zero extra cost or travel: it is the same building as the Monday afternoon tea, and the photo spots are the reason people go there.
near: Hoang Lien Street, beneath Absinthe Bar; next to Sun Plaza
